notes.title: Farm Animals Update
notes.content: [p][b]New Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added 4 new animals: [b]chickens, pigs, goats, and cows[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced 4 new farm products: [b]eggs, mushrooms[/b], [b]goat milk[/b], and [b]cow milk[/b], each corresponding to the new animals.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]⚙️ Performance Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Overall, FPS has been increased, and the game now looks better while running more smoothly.[/p][/*][*][p]Switched the anti-aliasing system from [b]TAA to TSR[/b] – TSR is more demanding, but it significantly reduces ghosting on moving objects and shimmering of distant vegetation.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced stuttering during gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🐞 Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]The [b]loader NPC[/b] should now operate more reliably, no longer freezing during loading/unloading tasks.[/p][/*][*][p]The loader no longer grabs products directly from the [b]player’s hands[/b] or from the [b]delivery truck[/b] when items are intended for sale.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing [b]crows to spawn incorrectly[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]customers would ignore items[/b] on the farmer’s shelf.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the [b]digging sound[/b] to play endlessly if the action was interrupted.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.2
notes.content:
[h2]What's New and Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reworked the notification system with improved grouping.
[*] Added a movable trash can — now you can dispose of trash anywhere.
[*] Fixed a bug where the truck could get stuck after a store upgrade.
[*] Added a water bill.
[*] You can now choose which goods to sell by toggling the option in the tablet.
[*] Fixed the dog can image.
[*] The player can now walk through customers and workers.
[*] Long titles are now resizable for better readability.
[*] Fixed invisible walls and dark lighting issues in the store.
[/list]
[h3]Loader Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the loader couldn't find an empty shelf in storage even when one was available.
[*] Fixed when the loader tried to fill a full shelf when adding a box to storage for the first time.
[*] Fixed an issue where the loader attempted to take a box from an empty shelf.
[*] Fixed when the loader got stuck after trying to fill a shelf with a missing label.
[*] Fixed a bug when the loader only replenished one shelf with a similar product.
[*] Fixed a bug where the loader attempted to place seeds on a regular shelf.
[*] Fixed an issue where the loader couldn't refill a farm shelf.
[*] Fixed a bug where multiple loaders attempted to perform the same task (moving the same box/refilling the same shelf).
[*] Fixed the "moonwalk" bug.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.1.2
notes.content:
[h3]Another Hot Fix just dropped.[/h3]
Here is what changed:
- Fixed storage shelf
- Fixed a bug when a player cannot see the vegetables on the garden bed after reloading
- Fixed stutters caused by cars and customers spawn
- Changed graphic settings - no more very high and ultra since it didn't make much of a difference visually but significantly affected performance
- Fixed a bug where buttons in the settings menu don't work for some resolutions 
- Rework of item throwing, now you can see a trace where you throw
- Added label with vegetable information on the garden bed

notes.title: Patch v0.1.1
notes.content:
- Fixed critical bug when customers don't pay for goods and block cash register
- Fixed dependencies between the movement speed of goods on the cash register and fps
- and a few more minor bugs
We saw that some players are still encountering a bug where customers can't put goods in the cash register, and we are trying to fix it as soon as possible.

notes.title: Patch v0.1
notes.content:
[h2]The first Hot Fix is dropped.[/h2]
[h3]We hope we have sorted the majority of the critical issues found so far.
Here are some of the things that were fixed:[/h3]
- Canceling the action when trying to drag an item now works correctly.
- Fixed UI getting stuck when opening the wheel.
- Fixed UI bug when you close Settings/Main menu but it stays on the screen
- More resolutions were added to avoid overlapping the widgets.
- Tutorials can be closed with Esc if the button doesn't work.
- Fixed a bug where the "Finish the day" button didn't appear.
- Fixed a bug where the player couldn't finish the day inside the house.
- Motion blur can be fully turned off now.
- Fixed a bug when you can't drop a box
- Fixed a bug with mouse sensitivity
- Fixed a bug when the name of the paint disappears after purchase
- Fixed a bug when sprinklers don't attach to the planter
- Fixed a bug when sprinklers don't save on day change
- Fixed a bug when customers don't pay for goods and blocked the cash register
- Fixed a bug when customers don't add goods to the cash register
- Partially fixed a bug when boxes got stuck in a hand truck, now if you add a new box, the old one will be dropped on the ground, hopefully, it will be fully fixed in the next update
- Performance improvements

Note that this is only the first patch, we working hard to bring more fixes.

Thank you for your support!
